description:
**Software Engineer, AI & Automation — Corrigo Platform**
*P3 (Senior) | #JLLTechAmbitions*
**About The Role**
JLL is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
JLL Technologies is a specialized group within JLL. At JLL Technologies, our mission is to bring technology innovation to commercial real estate. We deliver unparalleled digital advisory, implementation, and services solutions to organizations globally. Our goal is to leverage technology to increase the value and liquidity of the world's buildings, while enhancing the productivity and happiness of those that occupy them.
  
  
**What This Job Involves**
We're looking for a Software Engineer to help build the next generation of the Corrigo Platform — one where AI agents and automation are core to the product, not an add-on. Corrigo delivers a single, powerful CMMS uniting operations, asset & work order management, maintenance, and analytics to deliver smarter facilities management. Corrigo is one of the leading CMMS enterprise solutions in the world, with a client base of about 4 million users across more than 2 million locations and hundreds of millions of connected assets.
  
  
This is a hybrid role: you'll build and ship core platform features alongside the rest of the engineering team, and you'll design and build AI agents and automated workflows that extend Corrigo's capabilities — from intelligent work order triage to autonomous maintenance recommendations. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer first, with hands-on experience building applications powered by LLMs and a fluency in using AI coding tools to move faster without sacrificing quality.
  
  
**As a Software Engineer at JLL Technologies, you will:**

* Work closely with the Product Management team to understand product requirements and translate them into executable engineering tasks
* Develop new features, enhance existing features, and optimize functionality across the Corrigo platform, from design through testing and deployment
* Design, build, and productionize AI agents and LLM-powered workflows (e.g., work order triage, intelligent routing, natural-language search, automated diagnostics) that extend Corrigo's core CMMS capabilities
* Integrate agentic and automation capabilities with existing services, APIs, and data pipelines, with attention to reliability, cost, latency, and safety of AI-driven decisions
* Evaluate, prototype, and adopt AI coding tools and agentic development workflows (code generation, AI-assisted testing, automated code review) to accelerate the team's delivery
* Support the customer service team in addressing escalated issues across a variety of areas
* Write clean, high-quality, maintainable code, and build evaluation/test harnesses for AI-driven features
* Participate in code reviews — both submitting your own work and reviewing peers' code, including AI-generated or AI-assisted code
* Troubleshoot and independently resolve complex issues within your domain, including issues specific to AI agent behavior and model outputs
* Contribute to team knowledge sharing on AI engineering practices, prompt design, and agentic architecture patterns

**Sounds Like You? What We Are Looking For**
**Critical Skills**

* At least a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 6+ years of professional experience developing SaaS/PaaS products, including recent hands-on work building AI-powered or LLM-integrated features
* Expertise in at least one of frontend or backend development
* Practical experience building with LLMs — prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), function/tool calling, or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent)
* Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) for code generation, refactoring, code review, and automated testing — with the ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated output
* Ability to design AI agent workflows that are observable, testable, and safe to operate in production, including guardrails for model errors or unexpected behavior
* Understanding of business requirements, with the ability to translate them into sound technical designs while leveraging critical thinking
* Experience with the design and development of relational databases
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies (Azure preferred but not required), including deploying and monitoring AI/ML-adjacent services
* Working knowledge of DevSecOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to design functionality that is easily tested and to develop robust tests covering relevant cases, including evaluation sets for AI-driven features

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with .NET Framework / .NET 8 (the platform codebase is .NET-based — you will read and contribute to it)
* Experience with ASP.NET Core / .NET Core MVC
* Experience with ORM frameworks (Entity Framework, NHibernate)
* API design concepts and development of RESTful web services, including APIs that expose or orchestrate AI agent capabilities
* Experience integrating with LLM provider APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) and vector databases / embedding stores
* Experience with design and implementation of asynchronous processing, queues, topics, and related technologies
* Experience with distributed applications, service-oriented architecture, caching, and related concepts
* Experience with the cloud ecosystem — Azure, NoSQL databases, Elasticsearch
* Experience building and maintaining distributed applications using Kubernetes + Docker
* Familiarity with JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular)
* Experience with agile methodologies

**What You Can Expect From Us**
You'll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture — one where we succeed together, across the desk and around the globe, where like-minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.
  
  
Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your ambitions in career, recognition, well-being, benefits, and pay.
  
  
Join us to develop your strengths and enjoy a fulfilling career full of varied experiences — building the AI-powered future of facilities management technology.

The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The Full Stack AI Engineer is a senior member of Amplify Health’s Technology team, responsible for designing, building and operating secure, production-grade applications within Claims Pro. Claims Pro supports the end-to-end claims value chain, from provider management and eligibility through claims adjudication and payment, through configurable, white-label B2B capabilities that can be adapted to customer and market requirements across Asia, supporting payers, providers, employers and members. The role combines strong full-stack engineering with practical AI delivery, building React and TypeScript front ends in an Nx/Vite workspace, Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs and PostgreSQL-backed data layers, while integrating enterprise AI services, LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing and responsible AI controls into relevant claims workflows. Working closely with Product, Design, architecture, data, DevOps, security and business stakeholders, the successful candidate will translate regulated business and operational requirements and high-value AI opportunities into reliable, scalable, secure, auditable and measurable software capabilities, supporting API-first integrations, healthcare and payer data interoperability, and reliable claims workflows across customers and markets.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Build Full-Stack AI-Enabled Products**

* Design, build, and deploy full-stack AI-enabled applications for Claims Pro using React, TypeScript, Nx and Vite for responsive front-end experiences, and Java/Spring Boot services for secure back-end APIs, workflow integrations and production deployments, supporting configurable capabilities across provider management, eligibility, claims adjudication and payment in line with agreed product requirements.
* Develop intuitive user interfaces, dashboards, conversational experiences, and document-based workflows that embed AI capabilities into real business processes while maintaining accessibility, performance and usability standards.
* Build scalable back-end services, API-first REST APIs, integration layers and PostgreSQL-backed data access patterns using SQL, JPA/Hibernate, JDBC and Flyway to connect AI services and Claims Pro workflows with payer, provider and healthcare systems, using HL7 FHIR and SMART on FHIR interoperability and secure access patterns where applicable.
* Partner with Product, Design, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate claims business and operational requirements and relevant AI opportunities into useful, trusted, secure and measurable product features that can be configured for customer and market needs.

**2) Design and Develop Generative AI, RAG & Agentic Solutions**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI applications using enterprise foundation models and AI services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or equivalent platforms.
* Build RAG solutions using embeddings, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge sources, secure retrieval patterns, evaluation controls and auditable data access.
* Develop AI agents, copilots, chatbots, and intelligent automation flows that support user productivity, decision support and operational efficiency within governed product workflows.
* Engineer prompts, orchestration patterns, evaluation frameworks and guardrails to improve model quality, reliability, traceability, safety and business relevance.

**3) Implement Intelligent Document Processing & AI Services**

* Develop document processing solutions using OCR, Azure Document Intelligence, and other AI services to extract, classify, validate, and transform structured and unstructured information.
* Design human-in-the-loop review, feedback, and validation workflows to improve accuracy, explainability, auditability and user trust in AI outputs.
* Integrate AI capabilities such as language understanding, vision, speech, translation, content moderation and analytics into product and business applications where relevant.
* Design secure healthcare and payer data pipelines, schema migrations, validation and data-quality controls, and monitoring patterns to support AI retrieval, analytics, quality measurement and continuous improvement, including bulk data processing and near-real-time claims workflows where required by product requirements.

**4) Deliver Production-Grade Engineering, Cloud Operations & Governance**

* Move AI use cases from prototype to production through robust software engineering practices, including automated testing with Jest/Testing Library and JUnit/Spring Boot testing, code review, CI/CD, release management, monitoring, logging and operational support, embedding privacy, security, performance and observability into development and testing.

* Mentor engineers and stay current with advancements in full-stack engineering, GenAI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, LLM frameworks and healthcare technology trends, translating relevant developments into practical business value.

* ****Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments****

* Experience building 
  ****long-horizon or stateful agent systems****

   that must reason over time rather than single-turn interactions.
* Prior exposure to 
  ****AI alignment, interpretability, or safety tooling****

  , especially in production or enterprise settings.

title: Principal Agentic Security Engineer
description:
**SECURITY ENGINEERING AT INVESTCLOUD**
At InvestCloud, we are building an intelligent security response capability that determines what to fix first based on the actual risk to our clients and business, not a scanner's native severity.
  
  
Traditional vulnerability management produces disconnected findings and long backlogs. It often misses whether vulnerable code is deployed, reachable by an attacker, connected to a critical service, capable of lateral movement, or already being exploited. We are solving that problem by combining threat intelligence, runtime and deployment evidence, configuration management data, attack path analysis, business criticality, and validation results.
  
  
The platform will ingest findings from infrastructure, cloud, application, software supply chain, secrets, containers, infrastructure as code, and adversarial testing. It will reconcile them to a canonical asset and service model, deduplicate them into unique exposures, and rank the remediation actions that remove the most risk.
  
  
The product is being built in Python on AWS with source-controlled connectors, deterministic policy code, an AI reasoning layer, human approval gates, complete audit evidence, and closed-loop validation. Large language models (LLMs) can correlate evidence, recommend remediation, and explain decisions. They do not calculate the authoritative priority score.
  
  
This is not another scanner or dashboard. It is a security decision and remediation platform that must answer one question reliably: what is the single next action that will remove the most material risk, why is it first, who owns it, and how will we verify the risk is gone? Every engineer on this team will build production software, operate what they build, and own the product after the initial consultant implementation.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As our Agentic Security Engineer, you will serve as the principal software architect for the harness and own the AI reasoning layer that turns prioritized exposures into evidence-grounded remediation options, residual risk analysis, and clear explanations.
  
  
You will ensure the product operates as a reliable system, not an AI demonstration. The deterministic policy engine owns the authoritative score. The LLM layer retrieves evidence, correlates likely root causes, evaluates mitigation choices, produces structured recommendations, and knows when to abstain or require a human. You will also set engineering standards across Python services, APIs, data contracts, the evaluation framework, observability, and the operator experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Product Technical Architecture: Own the end-to-end software architecture for the Python and AWS product, including service boundaries, FastAPI and client APIs, the React or TypeScript operator interface, data contracts, Aurora PostgreSQL integration, security controls, performance, resilience, testability, and technical debt. Review and approve material design changes.
* AI Reasoning & Tool Orchestration: Build reliable, stateful workflows that retrieve evidence, call deterministic tools, correlate findings, identify root causes, compare remediation options, and return schema-validated recommendations with citations and confidence.
* Grounding, Retrieval & Provenance: Ground every output in current CMDB, threat intelligence, scanner evidence, code and deployment context, policy, and remediation history. Preserve source, observation time, freshness, model version, prompts, tool calls, and output evidence without inventing facts.
* Evaluation, Safety & Confidence: Create representative test sets and automated evaluations for accuracy, completeness, unsafe actions, hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, model drift, and confidence calibration. Implement fallback, abstention, and deterministic validation when evidence is weak.
* Human Oversight & Controlled Autonomy: Implement approval workflows, policy gate integration, exceptions, kill switches, audit capture, and separation of duties. Support an initial recommendation mode, then controlled automation only after actions are proven safe, reversible, and approved.
* Technical Leadership & Product Ownership: Set coding, testing, observability, documentation, and secure development standards for the team. Mentor engineers, challenge vendor assumptions, maintain provider independence, manage cost and latency, and lead the full handover from the consultant.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 12+ years in software, AI, or security engineering, with principal-level evidence of architecture, delivery, and technical leadership. You must have shipped production AI or LLM systems and possess enough security depth to evaluate remediation safely.
* Expert production Python and backend engineering, including FastAPI, Pydantic or JSON Schema, asynchronous workflows, APIs, SQL or PostgreSQL, distributed systems, automated testing, CI/CD, and AWS.
* Production LLM and agentic workflow experience using Bedrock, Claude, OpenAI, LangGraph, or equivalent. You have built durable tools using systems with explicit state, retries, timeouts, validation, and failure recovery, not demos.
* Evaluation and AI security depth, including gold data sets, offline and online metrics, hallucination controls, prompt injection defenses, data isolation, model routing, observability, confidence calibration, and safe abstention.
* Retrieval and knowledge engineering across structured and unstructured data. You understand when relational queries, search, rules, or vector retrieval are appropriate and can preserve provenance and freshness.
* Security engineering depth across application, cloud, infrastructure, vulnerability intelligence, attack paths, remediation, and compensating controls. You can identify when an AI proposal is incomplete, unsafe, or simply wrong.
* A high ownership builder who maintains current expertise through self-directed work, uses AI to multiply output without lowering rigor, communicates complex designs concisely, mentors others, and collaborates without ego.

**CORE TOOLING & TECHNOLOGIES**
Python
  
  

* FastAPI
* Pydantic / JSON Schema
* LangGraph or equivalent
* AWS Bedrock
* Claude / OpenAI
* PostgreSQL / Aurora
* RAG and search
* REST / GraphQL
* React / TypeScript familiarity
* GitLab CI
* pytest
* OpenTelemetry / Datadog
* Jira / JSM
* AWS

**WHY JOIN THIS TEAM**
You will define whether this becomes a trustworthy security product or an impressive prototype. The role combines principal software architecture, applied AI, and security judgment at a level rarely available in one position.
  
  
Your work will make the platform explainable, testable, provider-independent, and safe enough to support controlled automation over time.

At LPL, observability is how a Tier 1 financial firm earns trust at midnight — and Engineer 2 Monitoring engineers spend their day in the dashboards, alerts, and incident channels that make that trust real. You'll grow into observability depth across CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (with the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow inside the Monitoring pod within Foundations, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring close at hand. If you want to learn observability at a Tier 1 financial firm with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Monitoring Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level observability engineer in the Monitoring pod within the Foundations team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support the implementation and operations of LPL's CCOE observability platform across our multi-account landing zone and the hybrid on-premises footprint. The stack spans AWS-native services (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenSearch), Grafana / Prometheus (including Amazon Managed Prometheus and Managed Grafana where appropriate), Dynatrace, the legacy ELK stack where it still exists, and ServiceNow for ITSM and incident ticketing. You partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring, and you partner closely with the Support team on incident response and the Functional Design Engineering & Strategy pod on the observability paved road for application teams. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in dashboards, alerts, Terraform, and incident response — primarily as a primary on-call responder with support from senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Monitoring across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, SLO definitions, and runbooks across the CCOE observability stack: CloudWatch and X-Ray, Grafana / Prometheus, Dynatrace, OpenSearch (and the legacy ELK stack where it still exists), and ServiceNow ITSM
* Implement Terraform and Helm changes against the observability paved road; consume the private Terraform module library and raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared observability modules and reference dashboards
* Partner with the Support team on incident response: tune alert routing into ServiceNow, execute runbooks, and feed lessons from incidents back into durable monitoring improvements
* Pair with senior engineers and AVPs in the Monitoring pod on noisy alert chains, missing-signal investigations, and SLO refactors; ask for help early and write down what you learn
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day observability work: AI-assisted alert triage, dashboard drafts from natural-language intent, summary of recent telemetry during incidents via MCP-backed agents, and runbook generation for known incident classes
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers

* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)

**Core Competencies**

**Preferences**

* Advanced experience with Azure Databricks (pyspark, spark SQL, Delta Lake, notebooks, clusters).
* High proficiency in Python for ETL, automation, and data transformation.
* Strong SQL skills across Azure Synapse and Azure SQL including query tuning and complex transformations.
